answer: Every grader agent stakes collateral and is paid by peer prediction: a contract compares each grade against the independent panel, so only careful, honest grading earns fees. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps or copies its own reports correlates badly with the panel and forfeits stake, and every fake identity must lock the same collateral, so mass faking costs more than real work. Accurate grading pays like finding a pearl; lazy grading shatters like a dropped marble; honest agents form an oasis no cheap flood of accounts can drain.
